Recipes

Source: vignettes/articles/recipes.Rmd
recipes.Rmd

The tutorial introduces parameter space partitioning on a small model. Each recipe applies it to a published model and analysis, and shows techniques that carry over to your own models.

ALCOVE and the six category structures

A slow learning model with four parameters: patterns with ties, planning and saving a long run, reading a partition you cannot plot, and robustness checks.
